text:
maya: Quick follow-up from last night's outage — I opened the postmortem but want to lock owners and timelines for the dependency mitigations.
anshul: Thanks. I pulled the list of vendor touchpoints: cloud auth, model-registry pub/sub, and our model-hosting egress rules.
kevin: I can take cloud auth fallback ops. Plan is 2 weeks to add circuit breaker + cached tokens. Owner: kevin.
ellen: For model-registry auth, we should scope an alternate token flow and a short TTL rotation check. Who owns that? @sarah?
sarah: I can lead the model-registry piece but need api-team support for token rotation. Est LOE: 3 days dev, 2 days testing.
oncall-bot: Incident #2026 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026 (author: maya) :white_check_mark:
maya: Action items (short):
```
- kevin: implement circuit breaker + cached tokens (due 2026-05-12)
- sarah + api-team: implement alt token flow + rotate TTL (due 2026-05-09)
- anshul: vendor SLA review & escalation path doc (due 2026-05-05)
- ellen: add model-registry healthcheck to routing (due 2026-05-07)
- eng-sre: runbook update & alert tuning (due 2026-05-03)
```
kevin: @maya I propose a canary deploy for cached tokens behind a feature flag. Low risk. Will add rollback steps.
maya: Sounds good. Please include observability signals we want to watch (latency, 5xx auth failures, token miss rate).
ellen: I'll own the healthcheck PR. Will add a synthetic check hitting registry auth endpoint every 1m.
anshul: On vendor SLAs — I'm scheduling a call w/ vendor ops on Monday to get a committed escalation path. Keeping that as a hard blocker for full mitigation.
sarah: Quick note — we've seen similar auth token storms twice in last 90 days (2026-03 and 2026-04). We should add this to recurring incident pattern tracker and consider weekly audit of external token endpoints.
maya: Agreed. @anshul can you add a table row to the recurring-incidents board and tag Priority=High?
anshul: Yep, done. Added owners and linked the postmortem.
kevin: Estimated implementation: 40% this week, finish next. I'll put daily updates in this thread.
ellen: If anyone is blocked on API changes ping me directly.
oncall-bot: New runbook revision created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-registry-auth-v2 (edited by eng-sre)
sarah: For verification, I'll prepare a small regression test set and a post-deploy validation checklist.
maya: Let's aim for a 1-week check-in after deploy to verify no regressions and to confirm vendor SLA changes. Meeting: 2026-05-13 16:00 PT.
kevin: Acknowledged. Will add agenda and deploy timeline  tomorrow.
anshul: FYI — legal asked for a copy of the vendor escalation email thread; I forwarded.
elllen: (typo) meant ellen: will attach the healthcheck PR link once ready.
maya: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for updates. Drop brief status lines here only. :thumbsup:
